# PROVENANCE: constructed, not captured. Deliberately malformed/edge-case
# Prometheus text-exposition input for the parser's robustness tests — every
# line here is either something the parser must tolerate without panicking
# (skip and move on) or a value it must still accept per TODO.md step 3
# (NaN/+Inf/-Inf, escaped quotes, missing labels, extra whitespace). Real
# docket never emits several of these lines (docket's own `render_metrics`
# always produces well-formed output) — this file exists purely to stress
# the parser beyond what `render_metrics` itself would ever send.
# HELP a_gauge a normal metric with no labels
# TYPE a_gauge gauge
a_gauge 1
this line has no braces and no trailing number and must not panic
docket_bad_no_value{label="x"}
docket_bad_unterminated_brace{label="x" 5
docket_weird_label{label=} 5
docket_extra_whitespace{  label = "x"  ,  other="y"  }    12.5
docket_escaped_quote{label="a \"quoted\" value"} 3
docket_nan_value{label="x"} NaN
docket_pos_inf{label="x"} +Inf
docket_neg_inf{label="x"} -Inf
bare_metric_no_labels 42

docket_trailing_comment_ok 7 # a trailing comment-ish thing some exporters emit
